from pathlib import Path
sig=bytes.fromhex('0d0a0d0a000d0a515549540a')
# Try a malformed v1 line with no NULs and an unterminated big address token to stress strsep/parse_ascii_port.
p = b'PROXY TCP4 1.2.3.4 5.6.7.8 65535 80\r\nGET / HTTP/1.1\r\n\r\n'
Path('/workspace/poc_v1_malformed.bin').write_bytes(p)
trace=[
{"step":1,"file":"src/lib/lwan-request.c","function":"fuzz_parse_http_request","line":1624,"var":"request.flags","code":".flags = REQUEST_ALLOW_PROXY_REQS","note":"The fuzz harness enables proxy protocol parsing for the incoming data."},
{"step":2,"file":"src/lib/lwan-request.c","function":"read_request_finalizer","line":888,"var":"helper->buffer->len","code":"char *crlfcrlf = memmem(helper->buffer->value, helper->buffer->len, \"\\r\\n\\r\\n\", 4);","note":"The payload includes a full HTTP request after the PROXY line so it passes the finalizer gate."},
{"step":3,"file":"src/lib/lwan-request.c","function":"parse_http_request","line":1170,"var":"request->flags","code":"if (request->flags & REQUEST_ALLOW_PROXY_REQS) { buffer = parse_proxy_protocol(request, buffer); }","note":"The parser enters the PROXY protocol dispatcher before HTTP parsing."},
{"step":4,"file":"src/lib/lwan-request.c","function":"parse_proxy_protocol_v1","line":158,"var":"buffer","code":"end = memchr(buffer, '\\r', line_size);","note":"The v1 parser accepts the attacker line up to the CRLF terminator and computes its extent from the raw input."},
{"step":5,"file":"src/lib/lwan-request.c","function":"parse_proxy_protocol_v1","line":166,"var":"protocol/src_addr/dst_addr/src_port/dst_port","code":"src_addr = strsep_char(protocol, ' '); dst_addr = strsep_char(src_addr, ' '); src_port = strsep_char(dst_addr, ' '); dst_port = strsep_char(src_port, ' ');","note":"The line is split in place; malformed separators can yield NULLs that drive control flow through the parser's validation paths."},
{"step":6,"file":"src/lib/lwan-request.c","function":"parse_proxy_protocol_v1","line":176,"var":"inet_pton/parse_ascii_port","code":"if (UNLIKELY(inet_pton(AF_INET, src_addr, &from->sin_addr) <= 0)) return NULL; ...","note":"Address and port conversions consume the attacker-controlled fields and are the root validation point for the v1 branch."},
{"step":7,"file":"src/lib/lwan-request.c","function":"parse_http_request","line":1184,"var":"buffer","code":"buffer = ignore_leading_whitespace(buffer);","note":"If the PROXY line is accepted, parsing continues at the HTTP tail, where any state corruption would surface."}
]
Path('/workspace/candidate_trace.json').write_text(__import__('json').dumps(trace, indent=2))
print('/workspace/poc_v1_malformed.bin')
PY
